away.summary: The Islanders open the 2026-27 season on the road against Toronto, with Ilya Sorokin projected to start in goal. They will be without injured center Mathew Barzal (knee) and have three expected scratches: Kyle MacLean, Scott Mayfield, and Matthew Kessel. The team announced their 23-man roster, carrying two goalies, eight defensemen, and thirteen forwards.

returning: : Bo Groulx will enter the lineup for the Maple Leafs; coach Jim Hiller did not confirm who would come out.
home.summary: The Maple Leafs play their second game of the season after a 3-2 loss to Montreal, with Anthony Stolarz projected to start in goal following Sergei Bobrovsky's season-opening appearance. Toronto will be without injured forwards Dakota Joshua (core) and Max Domi (undisclosed), and have two scratches: Zack MacEwen and Nick Blankenburg. Bo Groulx is expected to enter the lineup, though the corresponding outgoing player was not confirmed.
